claim_boundary: Static recovery-design integrity only. This policy does not classify any additional runtime as stateful, execute a restore/recovery drill, or create target deployment evidence.
unclassified_runtime_policy: No persistence or recovery classification is inferred for the other 24 required runtimes from product names or layers alone.
target_execution_rule: A profile remains design_only_unexecuted and must require separate target execution evidence under the authoritative production deployment evidence manifest.
